typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	p_df_sub_class as string
}
source(output(
		{Activity ID} as string,
		{Activity Name} as string,
		{Original Duration} as string,
		{Actual Duration} as string,
		{Remaining Duration} as string,
		Start as string,
		Finish as string,
		{Actual Start} as string,
		{Actual Finish} as string,
		{Remaining Late Start} as string,
		{Remaining Late Finish} as string,
		Calendar as string,
		{Budgeted Units} as string,
		{Actual Units} as string,
		{Remaining Units} as string,
		WBS as string,
		{WBS Name} as string,
		{Cost Account} as string,
		Role as string,
		{GLOBAL - CHANGE MANAGEMENT} as string,
		{GLOBAL - EXECUTED BY TYPE} as string,
		{GLOBAL - FUNCTION} as string,
		{GLOBAL - MILESTONES} as string,
		{GLOBAL - OFFICE} as string,
		{GLOBAL - PHASE} as string,
		{GLOBAL - PRIME (GCOA V11)} as string,
		{GLOBAL - PRIME (GCOA V13)} as string,
		{GLOBAL - REGION} as string,
		{GLOBAL - SCHEDULE RISK ASSESSMENT} as string,
		{GLOBAL - STORAGE SOLUTIONS} as string,
		{GLOBAL - SUBPRIME (GCOA V11)} as string,
		{GLOBAL - SUBPRIME (GCOA V13)} as string,
		{GLOBAL - SUPPLY CHAIN} as string,
		{Spreadsheet Field} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	purgeFiles: true) ~> SrcP6EngrManHrs
FltIncorrectActivity derive(Project_Number = iif(length(regexSplit(WBS,'[-]')[1])>5,concat('99',regexSplit(WBS,'[-]')[1]),regexSplit(WBS,'[-]')[1]),
		PRIME = coalesce({GLOBAL - PRIME (GCOA V11)},{GLOBAL - PRIME (GCOA V13)}),
		SUBPRIME = coalesce({GLOBAL - SUBPRIME (GCOA V11)},{GLOBAL - SUBPRIME (GCOA V13)}),
		{Activity ID} = trim({Activity ID}),
		{Spreadsheet Field} = concat($p_df_sub_class,{Spreadsheet Field})) ~> dcGetProjectPrime
dcGetProjectPrime unpivot(output(
		Period as string,
		Units as string
	),
	ungroupBy(Project_Number,
		{Activity ID},
		{Activity Name},
		{Original Duration},
		{Actual Duration},
		{Remaining Duration},
		Start,
		Finish,
		{Actual Start},
		{Actual Finish},
		{Remaining Late Start},
		{Remaining Late Finish},
		Calendar,
		{Budgeted Units},
		{Actual Units},
		{Remaining Units},
		WBS,
		{WBS Name},
		{Cost Account},
		Role,
		{GLOBAL - CHANGE MANAGEMENT},
		{GLOBAL - EXECUTED BY TYPE},
		{GLOBAL - FUNCTION},
		{GLOBAL - MILESTONES},
		{GLOBAL - OFFICE},
		{GLOBAL - PHASE},
		{GLOBAL - REGION},
		{GLOBAL - SCHEDULE RISK ASSESSMENT},
		{GLOBAL - STORAGE SOLUTIONS},
		{GLOBAL - SUPPLY CHAIN},
		{GLOBAL - PRIME (GCOA V11)},
		{GLOBAL - PRIME (GCOA V13)},
		PRIME,
		{GLOBAL - SUBPRIME (GCOA V11)},
		{GLOBAL - SUBPRIME (GCOA V13)},
		SUBPRIME,
		{Spreadsheet Field}),
	lateral: false,
	ignoreNullPivots: true) ~> UnpivotData
UnpivotData filter(Units != '-99') ~> FltDummyRows
SrcP6EngrManHrs filter(!({Activity ID}=='No Activity ID'||isNull({Activity Name}))) ~> FltIncorrectActivity
FltDummyRows sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['p6_engr_hc_fcst.csv'],
	umask: 0022,
	preCommands: [],
	postCommands: [],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	mapColumn(
		Project_Number,
		{Activity ID},
		{Activity Name},
		{Original Duration},
		{Actual Duration},
		{Remaining Duration},
		Start,
		Finish,
		{Actual Start},
		{Actual Finish},
		{Remaining Late Start},
		{Remaining Late Finish},
		Calendar,
		{Budgeted Units},
		{Actual Units},
		{Remaining Units},
		WBS,
		{WBS Name},
		{Cost Account},
		Role,
		{GLOBAL - CHANGE MANAGEMENT},
		{GLOBAL - EXECUTED BY TYPE},
		{GLOBAL - FUNCTION},
		{GLOBAL - MILESTONES},
		{GLOBAL - OFFICE},
		{GLOBAL - PHASE},
		{GLOBAL - REGION},
		{GLOBAL - SCHEDULE RISK ASSESSMENT},
		{GLOBAL - STORAGE SOLUTIONS},
		{GLOBAL - SUPPLY CHAIN},
		PRIME,
		SUBPRIME,
		{Spreadsheet Field},
		Period,
		Units
	),
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> SnkP6EngrManHrs

properties.description:
Data Flow to pull data from ADLS Stg to ADLS Raw.
No schema defined in source or Target, Schema drift was used along with column rules to direct data into Sink.

typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	WildPath as string,
	FileName as string
}
source(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	purgeFiles: true,
	rowUrlColumn: 'Filename',
	wildcardPaths:[($WildPath + $FileName + '.csv')]) ~> srcP6EngrHeadCountStage
srcP6EngrHeadCountStage derive(Filename = concat($WildPath,substring(toString(currentTimestamp()),1,4),'/',substring(toString(currentTimestamp()),6,2),'/',substring(toString(currentTimestamp()),9,2),'/',$FileName,'_',replace(replace(toString(currentTimestamp()),'.',''),':',''),'.csv')) ~> setFileName
setFileName sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	rowUrlColumn:'Filename',
	umask: 0022,
	preCommands: [],
	postCommands: []) ~> snkP6EngrHeadCountRaw

	validateSchema: false,

		Phase,
